page: Microsoft Azure L80as_v5 is a storage-optimized virtual machine from the Lasv5 family, engineered for I/O-intensive workloads requiring extensive local capacity. Running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture, this instance is powered by dedicated AMD processors and provides 80 dedicated vCPUs alongside 640 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8 GB per vCPU allocation.

A central component of the L80as_v5 hardware configuration is the integration of 19,200 GB (19.2 TB) of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage. The instance does not include GPU acceleration hardware, focusing its physical resource allocation entirely on dense compute, large memory capacity, and high-throughput local disk storage. It also supports Azure Premium Storage for external managed disk attachment.

By coupling 80 compute threads with 640 GB of RAM and 19.2 TB of direct-attached NVMe storage, the L80as_v5 provides strong qualitative cost efficiency for organizations looking to consolidate large-scale transactional workloads onto a single instance without provisioning separate external SAN-based disk systems. One operational tradeoff to note is that local NVMe storage on such virtual machines is ephemeral, requiring resilient application-level data replication, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

The hardware configuration of the L80as_v5 is suited for large relational databases, distributed NoSQL datastores like Apache Cassandra and MongoDB, data warehousing operations, real-time analytics engines, and high-capacity transactional logging systems.
description: Microsoft Azure L80as_v5 is a high-density, storage-optimized virtual machine powered by dedicated x86_64 AMD processors under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 80 dedicated vCPUs and 640 GB of memory, delivering a generous 8 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage performance is anchored by 19,200 GB of directly bundled local NVMe SSD capacity alongside support for Azure Premium Storage. Lacking GPU accelerators, the instance directs its resources entirely toward I/O-bound and memory-heavy execution paths. With extensive NVMe capacity bundled directly into the instance profile, it eliminates the need for expensive network-attached disk arrays for temporary or clustered storage tiers. The L80as_v5 is strategically suited for high-throughput transactional databases, large NoSQL clusters, search indices, big data analytics engines, and write-heavy data pipeline processing.
